claim: Uncertainty-aware (calibrated) LLM guidance yields better task performance than uncalibrated LLM guidance in reinforcement learning, and both outperform traditional RL methods.
falsifier: On a similar sparse-reward grid-world task, compare an RL agent that blends LLM suggestions using uncertainty-weighted blending (calibrated) against one that uses raw LLM suggestions (uncalibrated) and against a standard RL baseline; measure success rate, reward AUC, and steps to goal.

conditions: uncertainty estimated via MC dropout with T=8 forward passes
exclusions: limited to the sampled system (MiniGrid-UnlockPickup), reported experimental conditions, and the specific calibration method

title: Calibrating LLM suggestions via–task success rate, reward principle

claim: Low-temperature growth of PECVD silicon nitride reduces interlayer stress, enabling deposition thicknesses up to 0.65 μm.
falsifier: Deposit PECVD SiN films at varying temperatures and measure interlayer stress and maximum crack-free thickness; verify that lower growth temperature correlates with lower stress and higher achievable thickness.

exclusions: limited to the reported PECVD system and experimental conditions

title: Low-temperature growth for achievable deposition thickness
